author: Fahrt
body:
Blurred Dreams
This is our tournament team, only apply if you are good please don't waste our time.

There is no application format, apply how you wish and what would the greater chance of getting into our team.Also Scrim,tournament experience would benefit your chances of joining Blurred Dreams. Also Muslim conversion would give you a greater chance(no Mexicans). If you live in Europe you have a better chance of getting in because of the time zones. 

Skype is mandatory also TeamSpeak and Mumble would be preferable.You must have the required tournament online time to join the team (exceptions can be made however)

Please have good sense of humour because you are very likely to get abused, remember we are not just looking for individuals with a strong skill set we also want players who will work well in a team environment

Owners: PickledEnvy, GeminiPvP, Notalgicular

Roster:


Frontlines

(Ronloyd)
(PickledEnvy)
(GeminiPvP)
(Jive0205)

Support

(Remyleouistiti)
(Rot43)

Defence 
Defenders must be reliable and not moan about their position.

(Ingigo)
(Zero1978)

Subs:

(Notalgicular)
(Cedd2701)
(Open)
(Open)

Our pet Gringo
Rockdude32

GeminiPvP's Skype - Gazcat42
PickledEnvy's Skype - b.banno321 

A Note: If someone applies for your position and are more active or better than you at your position you will be removed from the team.
This means even when our current roster is full you can still apply to replace other team members.

Thank you for your time and good luck.
- Pickle and Gemini
